d: Ukraine’s escalating long-range drone campaign is dealing a severe blow to Russia’s energy infrastructure, with 14 Russian oil refineries struck in just 23 days since the start of November, according to Bloomberg. The targeted facilities represent a combined processing capacity of more than 3.3 million barrels per day—accounting for over half of Russia’s total refining capability.
